description: The HRSA Data Warehouse is the US Health Resources and Services Administration's portal of maps, data, reports and dashboards about its health care programmes. It publishes Health Professional Shortage Area and medically underserved area designations with a lookup by address, locations of HRSA-funded health centres, Ryan White HIV/AIDS providers and organ transplant programmes, Uniform Data System reports on health centre patients, services and finances at national, state and centre level, the Health Workforce Explorer covering more than 40 occupations, grant awards and a poverty assessment and investment dashboard. HRSA-funded health centres serve more than 28 million people. Coverage is the United States and territories, with frequent updates such as the 2025 UDS data. Data are free to view and download, and developer tools include web services, APIs and GIS services, some after registration. Caveats: designations change often, programme data describe HRSA-funded services, not all providers, and dashboards mix years. Simulation uses: identifying areas short of primary care and mental health providers in healthcare access and disaster vulnerability studies, locating safety-net clinics as alternative care sites, and weighting populations by service gaps. Related records: the HRSA Area Health Resources Files (data-hrsa-area-health-resources-files) give county resource data and the Dartmouth Atlas data (data-dartmouth-atlas-hospital-service-areas-and-rates) give hospital geography.
